title: My commitments
description: What you applied for and what you were accepted into, with its deadline. Stepping back in time frees the slot with no penalty.

activos.title: You have no open commitments
activos.description: Apply to a campaign: once they accept you, it shows up here with its countdown.

historial.title: This is where the closed ones land
historial.description: Commitments you fulfilled, let expire or stepped back from are kept in this tab.

linea.solicitada: They're looking at your profile. We'll tell you as soon as they decide.
linea.aceptada: You're in: deliver your clip before the deadline runs out.
linea.entregada: You delivered your clip. Now it's on the payer to review it.
linea.cumplida: Clip approved: the commitment is settled.
linea.rechazada: They didn't accept your application for this campaign.
linea.retirada: You stepped back in time and your slot was freed.
linea.caducada: The deadline passed with no delivery and your slot was freed.
linea.en-disputa: There's an open dispute: the Clipealo team is on it.

plazo.quedan: {n, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
plazo.vencido: {n, plural, one {Deadline passed # day ago} other {Deadline passed # days ago}}

retirar.title: Step back from “{title}”?
retirar.description: Your slot is freed right away and there's no penalty. You can apply again while the campaign is still taking people.
retirar.cancelDescription: The payer will stop seeing it. You can apply again while applications stay open.
retirar.doneDescription: Your slot in “{title}” is free again.

disputa.title: Raise a dispute
disputa.descriptionClipero: Tell us what happened with “{title}”. The Clipealo team looks into it.
disputa.descriptionAgencia: Tell us what happened with {clipero} on “{title}”. The Clipealo team looks into it.

no-entrego.title: They never delivered
no-entrego.description: They accepted the campaign, the deadline passed and they don't answer.

no-revisa.title: Nobody reviews my clip
no-revisa.description: I delivered it and the campaign isn't deciding.

rechazo-injusto.title: I was rejected with no reason
rechazo-injusto.description: The rejection doesn't hold up against what the campaign asked for.

no-paga.title: Approved and unpaid
no-paga.description: My clip is approved and the payment hasn't arrived.

contenido.title: The clip doesn't comply
contenido.description: It's published and it skips the campaign requirements.

disputa.detalle: Tell it in your own words (optional)
disputa.detallePlaceholder: Dates, messages, links… whatever helps to understand it.
disputa.aviso: While the dispute is open, the campaign can't be closed and the money at stake stays reserved. Both sides see whatever is decided.
disputa.sentDescription: The Clipealo team reviews it and decides. We'll let you know the outcome.
disputa.none: There's nothing to dispute on this commitment right now.
disputa.abierta: There's already an open dispute on this commitment.
